verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party Disputes API ('Process Disputes'), a general Webhooks system, and an official MCP server, so the pieces exist for an agent to read disputes and work on responses programmatically. But the evidence is only page titles, with no detail on deadline fields, dispute webhook events, or uploading and submitting evidence. Missing for 10: documented dispute due-date/deadline fields, dispute-specific webhook events, evidence upload/submission endpoints with a draft-before-submit review flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
